summary: The game crashes when opening the inventory while in spectator mode
description: The Bug: The game crashes when opening the inventory while in spectator mode. A crash report regarding this has been attached and can be found below. This issue also doesn t appear to happen all of the time. Stack Trace: [ crash-2024-08-15_16.59.43-client.txt] Description: Rendering screen java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "faz.a(boolean)" because the return value of "ggr.t()" is null at ghd.h(SourceFile:578) at ghd.a(SourceFile:39) at com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList.forEach(ImmutableList.java:422) at ghe a.b(SourceFile:1231) at ghd.a(SourceFile:39) at ghe.a(SourceFile:1016) at ggv a.a(SourceFile:96) at ggv a.a(SourceFile:85) at ggv a.a(SourceFile:69) at ggv a.b(SourceFile:75) at fjn.e(SourceFile:96) at fri.a(SourceFile:160) at fri.a(SourceFile:133) at fri.a(SourceFile:102) at fqi.b(SourceFile:176) at fpt.a(SourceFile:126) at fqi.a(SourceFile:113) at fra.a(SourceFile:33) at fri.a(SourceFile:84) at fpt.c(SourceFile:117) at ggl.a(SourceFile:892) at fib.c(SourceFile:1305) at fib.f(SourceFile:894) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:256) Steps to Reproduce: - Open your inventory while in spectator mode. Observed Behavior: The game crashes. Expected Behavior: The game would not crash.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Use the command `/gamemode spectator` to switch to spectator mode.
4. Attempt to open your inventory.
5. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior:
When attempting to open the inventory while in spectator mode, the game unexpectedly crashes. This crash occurs intermittently, meaning that it does not happen consistently every time the action is performed. The crash is linked to a `NullPointerException` that arises during the rendering process of the inventory screen. Specifically, the error message indicates that the method `faz.a(boolean)` cannot be invoked because the return value of `ggr.t()` is null. This suggests that there may be a failure in the underlying code that handles the inventory interface in spectator mode, leading to the game being unable to properly render the inventory screen. 

This issue impacts gameplay by abruptly terminating the session, and it may cause loss of unsaved progress if the player is not cautious. The crash report attached provides further details, including the stack trace that outlines the sequence of method calls leading up to the crash, which could assist developers in diagnosing and addressing the underlying problem. 

To summarize, the observed behavior is a game crash when the inventory is opened in spectator mode, which disrupts the user experience and requires a restart of the game to continue playing.
Expected Behavior: When opening the inventory while in spectator mode, the game should allow the player to access their inventory without any crashes occurring. The inventory interface should display correctly, enabling the player to view and manage items without interruption. This expected behavior should occur consistently across all gameplay sessions, ensuring a stable experience while in spectator mode.
